message: Private Equity Case 2026.1 cover: Vasta Educação, dark magenta wave artwork with coordinator and members listed.
layout_trick: Dark full-bleed generative wave art with logo top-left and team credits in small bold bottom-left; the same wave motif is reused on dividers and Q&A.

message: Investment summary: 28.9% IRR / 2.71x MOIC over 6 years from a R$876mm minority entry at 8.1x and exit at 7.3x EV/EBITDA, with entry, exit and risks rationale.
layout_trick: Left column is a vertical IRR/MOIC spine (6-year line with diamond markers) feeding a right-hand rationale panel split into Entry / Exit / Risks rows of small numbered cards, each with a quantified chip (e.g. -4.9% IRR).

message: Vasta at a Glance: leading B2B K-12 private education platform with R$1.8bn net revenue, ~5,000 partner schools and recurring ecosystem economics.
layout_trick: Rounded card with illustration + brand pillars on the left, brand-logo row of school counts above a stacked column+line chart, and a bottom Key Stats strip of 6 big numbers separated by hairlines.

message: One-stop-shop platform (Core, Digital, Complements, Bilingual, School Management) gives Vasta ticket/penetration superiority vs Arco's scale strategy, with expanding margins.
layout_trick: Left stack of staggered rounded boxes hugging a half-donut wheel as an ecosystem metaphor, paired on the right with a scatter (ticket vs schools) and a margin line chart.

message: Private K-12 enrollment is flat (-0.5% CAGR) so growth comes from tuition pricing above IPCA, which lets schools invest in quality.
layout_trick: Progressive-reveal slide: top rounded panel holds stacked-percentage columns and a tuition vs IPCA line, with a pink callout card on the right; lower row is ghosted and revealed in later builds.

message: Only ~10% of private schools have scale to develop their own curriculum, and teaching quality is the main purchase driver, which is why they adopt learning systems.
layout_trick: Column chart of schools by student-count bucket with a dashed highlight box on the long tail, plus a quote card with attributed source and two icon-labelled drivers.

message: Vasta has the most complete K-12 portfolio, built through M&A, and ranks at the top of academic approvals (USP, Unesp, Unicamp) vs Poliedro, Anglo, Objetivo.
layout_trick: Five vertical pillar cards with icon, label and stacked brand-logo lineup (the logos prove the claim) beside a clustered bar chart with colored background bands per exam, and a B2C TAM callout with Brazil map.

message: Vasta's product stickiness is structural: churn stays low and net revenue retention rises while Arco's churn is higher and retention weaker.
layout_trick: Two matching area charts (Arco x Vasta churn and NRR) side by side, with a testimonial card with face photos and magenta name bar overlapping the lower right corner.

message: Cross-sell, lower selling expenses and higher EBITDA margin combine into stronger unit economics than Arco.
layout_trick: Three tinted header cards with chevron arrows (cause chain) each over a Vasta vs Arco chart, closed by a numbered conclusion bar with equals sign leading to 'Stronger unit economics'.

message: LTV/CAC formula (gross margin x ACV x partner schools / churn over selling expenses) shows Vasta's return trending above Arco's.
layout_trick: Slide 14 dimmed behind a modal-style rounded white popup with a boxed LTV/CAC formula and a single line chart, an overlay used to zoom into one metric.

message: Premium brands carry pricing power: Vasta ticket +69% vs IPCA +21%, validated by a brand price ladder and Plurall usage field evidence.
layout_trick: Three column cards with distinct fills (brand ladder bars, highlighted gradient pricing-index chart, phone mockup showing app-store stats), the middle one in solid magenta for emphasis.

message: Core revenue grew +89% in 2021-2025, driven almost entirely by average ticket (73 p.p.) and school count (15 p.p.), with density contributing zero.
layout_trick: Single contribution bar split into colored segments (ticket/schools/density) with a 3-icon decomposition below, plus a CAC-payback range strip and four NPV-by-depth bubbles of increasing size.

message: High switching cost (R$394k per school, 1.3x annual fee) and 92.8% GRR keep returns resilient even under severe stress.
layout_trick: Horizontal bars stack the cost components of switching to a total row, and a donut GRR with three icon KPIs sits beside a stress-case NPV ladder, with two tinted takeaway banners at the bottom.

message: Northeast is a whitespace premium: scarce premium systems, low private penetration and a ticket headroom vs Sao Paulo, with a closing window.
layout_trick: Three numbered white cards (01-03) each with a mini chart, joined to a solid magenta conclusion panel listing the whitespace arguments and ending in a 'Premiumization -> Volume' pill.

message: The flagship flywheel: one anchor school drives approvals, local reputation, school demand and B2B system adoption.
layout_trick: Five circle icons connected by arrows with a return loop arrow beneath, next to three bordered case cards (Bernoulli, Poliedro, Anglo), and a callout bar quantifying the single-flagship payoff.

message: Recife ranks highest on capital attractiveness, so the entry starts there, with Natal and Joao Pessoa as phased follow-ups and target neighborhoods mapped.
layout_trick: Northeast map with numbered phased-rollout pins beside a ranked bar+table of cities, and three satellite-map neighborhood thumbnails with R$/m2 prices along the bottom.

message: Cautious entry in Recife is the dominant strategy in a 3x3 payoff matrix against Bernoulli's reaction, and the TAM funnel narrows to ~40 schools today.
layout_trick: A 3D tiered funnel (TAM to SAM to SOM to Today) sits between a 3x3 game-theory payoff grid with the Nash cell highlighted in magenta and a 'where the 100 come from' split, with a four-KPI row beneath.

message: The expansion plan pays off: 25% IRR, 4x MOIC, 95% chance of positive NPV, payback 2031, with real options (Salvador, Natal, Fortaleza) staged as future bets.
layout_trick: Three big-number KPIs across the top, a J-curve cash line with 'max risk' and 'upside' callouts, and chained option pills (Now / if validated / separate option) with a recommendation bar at the foot.

message: Educbank is a diamond in the rough: a K-12 B2B fintech with structural demand, poor current performance and strong potential, not yet profitable.
layout_trick: Violet palette signals a different entity (Educbank) inside a magenta deck; a header summary box with a cap-table donut sits over three tinted pillars (Demand / Performance / Potential) with a Brazil choropleth and isometric building.

message: Arco's Isaac acquisition is the playbook: after full acquisition Isaac became a core growth driver, validating Vasta's Educbank thesis.
layout_trick: Logo equation badge (arco -> isaac) at left, a video-call quote card on the right, and two columns+line charts below with a dashed box marking the inflection year.

message: Educbank is entered gradually via Marrakech cash-out and cash-in, with cap table shifting to Vasta and revenue growing from cross-sell.
layout_trick: Stacked 100% cap-table columns by year and a capital-invested bar chart on the left, framed by a rounded outline panel for a stacked revenue breakdown by product with growth labels on the right.

message: Revenue grows from R$947mm to R$6.5bn by 2035E, led by core and cross-sell with VCP I and II modules, under five stated assumption groups.
layout_trick: Large stacked revenue column chart with segment legend and total/growth labels on the left, numbered assumptions list (I-V by line item) in a narrow right column.

message: Margins and leverage improve over the projection: gross, EBITDA, EBIT and net margin lines up, FCF conversion rises and net debt/EBITDA falls.
layout_trick: Two stacked chart pairs per side (margins lines, FCF columns with conversion line, debt stacked area with leverage line) each introduced by an italic one-line takeaway headline.

message: Deal terms: Cogna's CJE injects R$876mm primary capital at 8.1x entry multiple, taking 15% post-money, for 2.71x MOIC and 28.9% IRR.
layout_trick: Pre- and post-money shareholder donuts bracket a central entry box with the building image, and below a horizontal multiple scale (trading comps, tender offer, entry, transaction comps) positions the 8.1x entry.

message: Legal deal structure: shareholders' agreement and term sheet (board seat, tag along, liquidation preference, anti-dilution, put option) in legal terms.
layout_trick: Two-panel layout with a thin ownership bar and a bylaws illustration on one side and a boxed numbered term sheet on the other; signature row adds credibility.

message: Cash flow and returns: MOIC and IRR are driven mainly by EBITDA expansion, and the IRR rises from 23.0% before VCPs to 28.9% consolidated.
layout_trick: Two waterfalls (MOIC breakdown and EBITDA bridge from 2026 to 2031) plus a stepped IRR build bar chart, with a compact cash-flow table on top and an italic takeaway headline for each chart.

message: Two exit paths compared: sale to a financial player (28.9% IRR, 7.3x) vs buyback by Cogna (26.2% IRR, 6.9x) with different multiple discounts.
layout_trick: Slide split by a vertical hairline into two exit paths, each with logo lineup or rationale, a waterfall and a closing two-KPI box (IRR and exit multiple) for direct comparison.

message: IRR sensitivity to entry multiple (5.1x-11.1x) and exit premium/discount (-30% to +15%), base case 28.9% at 8.1x entry and 0% premium.
layout_trick: Pink gradient heatmap table with the base-case cell outlined by a thick border and bold row/column cross, presented as a rounded popup over a dimmed slide.

message: Main risks mapped by likelihood vs impact across company, macro and execution types, each quantified as IRR hit (Educbank integration fail -4.9% IRR down to Northeast expansion fail -2.4%).
layout_trick: 5x5 likelihood x impact grid with coded risk tiles (E1, C1, M1...) placed in cells, color-coded by type, paired with a ranked list on the right whose each row shows the assumption change and its IRR delta.

message: Presentation Network: a clickable table of contents listing all slides with section dividers in bold.
layout_trick: Full-bleed magenta index slide in three columns of underlined hyperlinks with section starts in bold, enabling navigation across a 40-slide deck.

message: Section divider 01 Business Overview with a six-section tracker (Overview, Thesis, VCP, Valuation, Deal, Risks).
layout_trick: Giant ghosted pale-pink section number behind a bold title, italic subtitle and a six-item section tracker with the current one underlined; the footer nav on content slides repeats the same sections as a progress bar.

message: Divider for Thesis I: A Portfolio Built To Stick.
layout_trick: Same divider template repeated per thesis with the slogan as subtitle so each section announces its claim before the evidence.

message: Team presentation of five members with photos, role, course and semester.
layout_trick: Five circular portrait photos with magenta ring borders in an evenly spaced row, with name bold and role/course/semester stacked under each.
